stories.title: Takeaways as Rays even series against Guardians
stories.summary: Tampa Bay pulls out the Game 2 win thanks to Freddy Peralta's six scoreless innings.

stories.title: Peralta shuts down Guardians as Rays even ALCS in Game 2
stories.summary: The Guardians knew what was coming but still couldn't touch Rays starter Freddy Peralta, who topped 99 mph on his fastball and threw six scoreless innings as the Rays took Game 2 of the ALCS.

stories.title: Game 1 star Ramirez shoulders blame as two costly miscues sink Guardians
stories.summary: Guardians star Jose Ramirez expressed regret for a pair of costly fourth-inning miscues that led to three unearned runs for the Rays, who evened the series with a 3-1 win in Game 2.

stories.title: 'Adamant' Ohtani will be in Dodgers' Game 3 NLCS lineup, Roberts says
stories.summary: Los Angeles Dodgers manager Dave Roberts told reporters Tuesday that struggling superstar Shohei Ohtani will be in the lineup for Game 3 of the NLCS on Wednesday vs. the Milwaukee Brewers.

stories.title: Hill found liable for 2 counts of battery in mixed verdict; wife awarded $500K
stories.summary: A Miami jury returned a mixed verdict in the assault and battery civil trial against Tyreek Hill, finding the former NFL receiver liable for two counts of battery but not liable for the eight other claims made by his estranged wife, Lakeeta Vaccaro.
